result.markdown: --- title: "March Madness Bracket — Scoring & Rules" format: html: theme: cosmo toc: true pdf: documentclass: article execute: echo: true warning: false message: false --- ## Overview Welcome to our class March Madness bracket challenge! Points are awarded by round, with an **extra upset bonus in Round 1**. --- ## Scoring by Round - **Round 1 (64 teams):** 1 point per correct pick - **Upset bonus:** +1 extra point *in Round 1 only* for correctly picking an upset where the **lower seed beats the higher seed**, **excluding 8 vs. 9 games**. - **Round 2 (32 teams):** 2 points per correct pick - **Round 3 — Sweet 16:** 3 points per correct pick - **Round 4 — Elite Eight:** 4 points per correct pick - **Round 5 — Final Four:** 5 points per correct pick - **Round 6 — National Championship:** 6 points per correct pick > “Third round = 3 points” and so on—i.e., the point value increases by 1 each round. ### Upset Definition (Round 1 only) - An **upset** is when the **numerically larger seed** defeats the **numerically smaller seed** (e.g., a 12 beats a 5). - **No upset credit** for 8 vs. 9 matchups. - Each correctly predicted eligible upset in **Round 1** earns **+1 extra point**. --- ## Quick Examples ### Example A — Round 1 upset you called correctly - You picked a **12** to beat a **5**, and it happened. - Points: **1 (correct pick)** + **1 (upset bonus)** = **2 points** ### Example B — Round 1 correct pick that is not an upset - You picked a **2** to beat a **15**, and it happened. - Points: **1 point** (no upset bonus) ### Example C — Sweet 16 correct pick - You picked the winner of a Sweet 16 game correctly. - Points: **3 points** --- ## Bonus Points - **Beat-the-Instructor Bonus:** If your total score **beats my score**, you earn **+1 bonus point**. - **Placement Bonuses (class leaderboard):** - **1st place:** +5 - **2nd place:** +4 - **3rd place:** +3 --- ##
